answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 4 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 78 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. Without kernel the panel is blind, without haven the farm is free, and without knoll nobody can prove what happened.
